question: What still requires excessive ChatGPT reasoning/tool orchestration after reusable workflows exist?

proposals.title: Composable workflow graphs + lifecycle transactions
proposals.evidence: Gen3 cut authored workflow bytes by 0.674 but the benchmark still needed 18 reusable invocations; 8 were lifecycle/recovery invocations, with self-update requiring four named workflows and bad recovery three.
proposals.expected_benefit: Let one auditable reusable workflow call other versioned workflows with explicit dependencies/acceptance gates, reducing residual ChatGPT sequencing without hiding underlying Code Mode traces.

proposals.title: Richer transactional/AST editing
proposals.evidence: The largest compact invocations still carried procedure-specific edit material: multi-file-patch=245B, lab-self-evolve=231B, compile-test=170B, public-repo-investigation=154B; observed Code Mode ops={'exact_replace': 34, 'command': 85, 'copy': 6, 'self_update': 2, 'assert_file': 15, 'git_patch': 8, 'service': 2, 'job': 1, 'inspect': 1}.
proposals.expected_benefit: Reduce the reasoning needed to manufacture exact old/new strings or patches while preserving preview, deterministic checks, rollback, and provenance.

proposals.title: Guest-local browser automation skill
proposals.evidence: The public-repo reusable workflow passed, but it still uses Git/HTTP/CLI only; Gen3 added no rendered DOM/browser primitive inside the isolated guest.
proposals.expected_benefit: Make dynamic-site investigation and browser-based testing reusable without widening host authority.

proposals.title: Adaptive bounded recovery policies
proposals.evidence: Gen3 benchmark used 2 bounded retries; trace step failures by op={'exact_replace': 7, 'command': 1}. During implementation, candidate-vs-LKG acceptance semantics and a reusable-workflow CLI exit-code bug required explicit diagnosis before the clean benchmark.
proposals.expected_benefit: Encode known transient/recovery state machines as inspectable policies so repeated failure diagnosis becomes local and bounded rather than ChatGPT-authored.

proposals.title: Parallel independent workflow experiments
proposals.evidence: The two slowest benchmark tasks consumed 17514.79 ms of 24767.96 ms (0.707): reusable_lab_self_update_restart_verification=10662.42ms, bad_candidate_recovery_through_reusable_workflow=6852.37ms.
proposals.expected_benefit: Run independent research/build/candidate checks concurrently while retaining per-workflow audit, resource bounds, and containment.
